name: Hanaoka
sourceUrl: https://www.hanaoka-restaurant.com/ (dinner: https://www.hanaoka-restaurant.com/menus/dinner.pdf ; sushi: https://www.hanaoka-restaurant.com/menus/sushi.pdf, exact menu-PDF paths as linked from the site's menu subpages)
notes: restaurant's own site and both dinner and sushi PDF menus parsed cleanly with pdftotext; two other menus linked from the same site (lunch and party-platter PDFs) are corrupted at the source -- truncated at exactly 1,048,576 bytes on every fetch attempt, including from a Wayback Machine archive copy, so the corruption predates our fetch. Extracted embedded JPEGs from both corrupted PDFs anyway; they turned out to be small ad/graphic banners (e.g. 'SAPPORO DRAFT BEER', a food glamour photo), not full-page text renders, so no lunch or platter prices were recoverable this way. Filed with dinner + sushi content only (the two largest, core sections); lunch and platter subset intentionally omitted rather than guessed at. Some size/quantity variants sharing one price line in the source PDF were split into separate dish rows with the shared price. Vietnamese-style menu numbering stripped from names.
